facts.fact: Devan leaves a covered dish of rice and curd, a cup and a brazier-warmed cloth ready for Neela's dawn return; she never told him what the morning after a turning costs.
facts.why: needed because technique 9 (responsive care) requires a specific noticed need.

facts.fact: Chinna's wager on why the warden barred his shutters has no winner; Chinna keeps the stakes and guesses without asking.
facts.why: needed because it closes the ch10 running gag as a relief valve.

facts.fact: Neela's vow publicly says she came 'sold' and names Raiu, Ammu and every living household member; she does not mention odiyans, Ittan or the guild before Muthu.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires her spoken vow, and Muthu will report it.
